findings.title: Pod affinity requires pods that do not exist
findings.cause: its required podAffinity places it only beside pods labelled app=cache (topologyKey kubernetes.io/hostname), and namespace kd-pod-affinity-no-match has no such pod, so no node qualifies (the other pods there have app=redis); Deployment web has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.detail: 0/1 nodes are available: 1 node(s) didn't match pod affinity rules. preemption: 0/1 nodes are available: 1 Preemption is not helpful for scheduling.

evidence.what: required podAffinity: pods labelled app=cache, topologyKey kubernetes.io/hostname
evidence.command: kubectl get pod web-9ff68f68b-6h2gv -n kd-pod-affinity-no-match -o jsonpath='{.spec.affinity.podAffinity}'

evidence.what: no pod in namespace kd-pod-affinity-no-match is labelled app=cache

findings.fix: Correct the podAffinity selector to the labels the pods it should run beside carry, start those pods first, or make the rule preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution so the pod can run without them.
